The first release of PST Viewer: open old Outlook archives and Netscape/Thunderbird mail on your Mac — no Outlook, no conversion, nothing is changed in your files.

## What it does

- Opens Outlook archives (`.pst` and `.ost`) from Outlook 97 up to today, including the old 2 GB ANSI files.
- Opens old mbox mail from Netscape Communicator, Mozilla and Thunderbird: just choose the folder that contains `Inbox` and `Sent`.
- Shows mail, attachments, contacts, calendar items and tasks in three columns, like Outlook and Apple Mail.
- Searches by subject, sender or recipient, in one folder or everywhere, optionally in the message text too.
- Exports messages to `.eml` or `.mbox`, so you can bring them into Apple Mail or Thunderbird.
- In English and Dutch, in light and dark mode. Remote images in mail are blocked to protect your privacy.
- Keeps itself up to date: PST Viewer tells you when a new version is available.

## Install

1. Download **PST-Viewer.zip** below.
2. Double-click the zip file in your Downloads folder.
3. Drag **PST Viewer** to your Applications folder and open it.

The app is signed and checked by Apple, so it opens with a double-click. It needs macOS 13 Ventura or later and runs on both Apple silicon and Intel Macs.

More help: https://mukreb.github.io/mac-pst-viewer/
